name: Asymmetric Winner Pyramid
strict_definition: Candidate must have higher return AND lower absolute max drawdown than v5.10C in both 2023 and 2024, while preserving active-week >=2% rate. Only the top validation-passing configuration may open final. Final must then beat v3.2 on return and drawdown while preserving active-week >=2% rate.
notes: v5.9C hazard detector is frozen from 2021-2022 quantiles.
All post-entry decisions use only information available by that session close; intraday stop/target is evaluated first, stop-first on same-bar ambiguity.
Final research period is not used to choose configurations.
